project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 5 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 0 of 42 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Disley qualifies as a local detour through Cross base in the churchyard of St Mary's Church and CHURCH OF ST MARY. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Disley: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Disley offers Cross base in the churchyard of St Mary's Church, CHURCH OF ST MARY, CANAL BRIDGE NUMBER 26 within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Cross base in the churchyard of St Mary's Church
